A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the podocytic phenotype can be gradually modulated by high glucose in vitro, and that this modulation is not directly dependent on the presence of WT1.

The main takeaway from our work is that
podocyte phenotype is not a stable feature and is modulated by the presence of high glucose.
the time needed for podocyte phenotype changes to occur is not instantaneous, as has been previously suggested.
podocytes are not a static entity but are rather a dynamic population that can adapt to changes in their environment.
